tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search active job listings in Norway on Kollegia (kollegia.no), including jobs from NAV (arbeidsplassen.nav.no). Returns up to 20 jobs, newest and best title matches first, each with title, employer, location, employment type, deadline, salary (stated in the ad, or an approximate SSB-based estimate marked 'ca.'), a short summary, requirements and the url on kollegia.no where the user reads the full ad and applies. Content is in Norwegian. Combine filters freely; all are optional but give at least one.

q.description: Free text matched against job title, employer and occupation, e.g. 'kokk', 'sykepleier natt', 'Rema 1000'. Norwegian words work best.

location.description: Norwegian municipality, city district or county, e.g. 'Bergen', 'Tromsø', 'Grünerløkka', 'Vestland', 'Oslo'. Regions like 'Nord-Norge' or 'Vestlandet' also work, and 'hjemmefra' gives remote jobs.

occupation.description: Occupation name in Norwegian, e.g. 'Kokk', 'Elektriker', 'Barnehagelærer'. Matched against job titles.

employment_type.description: One of: heltid (full-time), deltid (part-time), fast (permanent), vikariat (temporary), sesong (seasonal/summer job), engasjement (fixed-term), lærling (apprentice).

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get details for one active job on Kollegia by its id (from search_jobs): the ad text (shortened, without contact details), requirements, salary, deadline, location, employer and the kollegia.no url where the user applies. Returns an error if the job is no longer active.

id.description: Job id from search_jobs (the last part of https://kollegia.no/jobs/{id}).

tools.name: salary_for_occupation
tools.description: Salary statistics for an occupation in Norway: median monthly salary for full-time employees, lower and upper quartile and estimated hourly wage (Statistics Norway, SSB), plus the number of open positions on Kollegia and in Norway overall (NAV). With a location, adds the number of open jobs there. Links to the occupation page on kollegia.no. SSB salaries are national, not per location.

location.description: Optional. Norwegian municipality, city district or county, e.g. 'Bergen', 'Tromsø', 'Grünerløkka', 'Vestland', 'Oslo'. Regions like 'Nord-Norge' or 'Vestlandet' also work, and 'hjemmefra' gives remote jobs.

tools.name: employer_jobs
tools.description: Find an employer on Kollegia by name (or kollegia.no slug) and list its active jobs, with the link to the employer page or career page on kollegia.no. Returns suggestions when the name is ambiguous.

employer.description: Employer name, e.g. 'Rema 1000', 'Oslo universitetssykehus', or a kollegia.no slug.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Free-text search in active job listings in Norway on Kollegia, e.g. 'kokk i Bergen', 'deltidsjobb Trondheim', 'sykepleier Tromsø'. Place names and words like heltid/deltid/sommerjobb in the query are used as filters. Returns id, title and url per job; use fetch with the id for the full ad. (search_jobs offers the same with explicit filters.)

query.description: What the user is looking for, in Norwegian or English.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full ad for one job by id (from search or search_jobs): title, text, url on kollegia.no and key facts as metadata.
